title: Doug sees beings through the punctured porthole
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Doug sees beings through the punctured porthole, about March 25, 1948 at New Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Doug was specific about that hole for the rest of his life. Doug puts his eye in the punctured port hole. He sees two small figures slumped over a panel.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that at a crashed saucer near Aztec, New Mexico, in March 1948, a man named Doug Noland put his eye to a small hole punched through one of the craft's portholes. Through it, Michels says, Doug saw two small figures slumped over a control panel, and he stayed specific about that hole for the rest of his life. If true, it would be an eyewitness sighting of dead or injured alien crew.
